description: The line plot illustrates the training accuracy of three different models over a series of epochs. The x-axis, labeled "Epoch," is linear and ranges from 0 to 400, with tick labels at intervals of 50. The y-axis, labeled "Training Accuracy," is also linear and ranges from 0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot includes three lines: a red line representing the model "C^3_Ab = 128/2," a blue line representing the model "LoRA_p = 1," and a gray line representing the "Linear" model. The red line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.2 and increases sharply to reach 1.0 by the 50th epoch, maintaining this level throughout the rest of the epochs. The blue line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.2 and increases more gradually, reaching an accuracy of about 0.8 by the 400th epoch. The gray line starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.2 and increases steadily, reaching an accuracy of about 0.6 by the 400th epoch.
